1) Evidence pack: we attached our SOC 2 Type II report (redacted PDF link via Drive) and a one-page KMS/HSM + encryption summary. Naomi, please see the inline notes for any legal gaps.

2) Hosting recommendation: for CareAvenue's described use (claims ingestion + messaging with PHI), most customers opt for Dedicated capacity when they require tenant isolation + clear SLA/throughput. Hosted API + signed BAA is acceptable for lower-risk profiles and speeds time-to-market; Private VPC is recommended if you need customer-controlled networking or full air-gapped deployment.

3) Decision checklist (high-level):
- Hosted API + BAA: fastest (days), Redwood manages keys by default; we support CMK via cloud KMS in many regions.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pool for your account, predictable throughput, SOW + onboarding (~4-6 weeks).
- Private VPC / on-prem: longest lead time, full network isolation, support for customer-managed HSMs (timeline variable).
